title: Counter Sale is never offered in the Bill Invoices To window
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B in Edit Customer.
  • Use the organization's Counter Sale customer, so its name can be typed.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click "Change" beside "Bill Invoices To" on the left card.
  3. Type the Counter Sale customer's name in the "Bill Invoices To" field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Change" shows beside customer B's name.

Step 2:

  • The "Bill Invoices To" window opens.

Step 3:

  • Only "[customer A's name] (this customer)" is listed.
  • The Counter Sale customer is not offered.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-N5: “Counter Sale never appears in the field's options.”
  • Key Decisions: “Counter Sale is never the Bill To for another customer, and always bills itself by default.”
  • Terminology: “Counter Sale → the system customer walk-ins are invoiced to. A normal customer in this PRD, never a Bill To for others.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Counter Sale not offered" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", New, no before exists).
